title: Feature impact map: per-feature impact measures per ML x asset x market x timeframe, rolled up into a drill-down heat map
note: (operator 2026-11-11 ~09:50Z) Goal: know which features matter, where, and where to focus data collection. Measures (NOT just raw correlation with price): (a) model-internal importance per ML (SHAP / gain, on the model's own OOF data); (b) model-free predictive power per feature: rank information coefficient vs forward return at the ML's horizon, per symbol / asset class / timeframe, with stability over time; (c) optional ablation lift for top features. Store one long table (ml, feature, feature_family, symbol, asset_class, venue, timeframe, window, measure, value, n, se) refreshed by a scheduled off-VM job (trainer/Actions, no Claude); then UI: heat map of feature-family x asset class (or ML type), drill down to feature x symbol x timeframe, with n and provenance on hover; and a 'where to invest in data' view (high-impact families with thin coverage). Pieces: compute job + store (ML lane), API route, SPA view (UI lane). Fits M23 signals catalog; also feeds ML-DEEP-AUDIT-FABLE and frontier research.
